summary: Israeli strike in Gaza City kills Hamas internal security chief Naim Abu Nahal. Iran conducts multiple missile launches from Fars, Lorestan, Kermanshah, and Kurdistan provinces. sections.executive_summary: Israeli strike in Gaza City eliminates Hamas internal security chief Naim Abu Nahal, marking a significant decapitation of Hamas's internal security apparatus. Iran conducts a series of missile launches from at least four provinces, demonstrating dispersed launch capabilities. Lebanese border monitoring shows sustained high alert tempo with 143 daily alerts, a 54% weekly increase, indicating persistent low-intensity conflict along the Blue Line.

points: On 24 Nov 2026, Iran conducted at least five missile launches from multiple sites: Nurabad Mamasani in Fars Province (17:48 local), Aligoodarz in Lorestan Province (17:47Z), Kenesht Canyon in Kermanshah Province (17:38 local), and two missiles from Saqqez in Kurdistan Province (21:15 local). All reports via FromIran dashboard with 120-second delay. (Source: @shin_persian/12827, @shin_persian/12836, @shin_persian/12830, @shin_persian/12837)

Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz stated Iran is "in the process of developing chemical weapons" but has not yet attained capability to attack Israel; Israel will not allow such development. Katz also said Iran is developing missiles with 4,000km range and plotting to assassinate US President Trump and senior officials. (Source: @manniefabian/59581, @yediotnews25/138490, @amitsegal/67502)

According to Israeli sources, Iran has pursued chemical weapons for over a decade; materials related to chemical program were found in 2018 Mossad nuclear archive seizure but not examined to focus on nuclear materials. Estimated few years to mate chemical warhead on ballistic missiles. (Source: @yediotnews25/138499)
President Masoud Pezeshkian said Iran is negotiating with the US and other countries but will maintain its dignity and not surrender to arrogance or pressure. (Source: @yediotnews25/138491)
UK Maritime Trade Operations issued warnings 220-26 and 221-26 on 24 Nov 2026 for maritime security in regional waters. (Source: @shin_persian/12833, @shin_persian/12834)

IDF struck and killed Naim Abu Nahal, 50, director general of Hamas internal security apparatus, in Gaza City. Joint statement by PM Netanyahu and Defense Minister Katz noted his predecessor was captured three months prior. (Source: @manniefabian/59578, @amitsegal/67497, @manniefabian/59579)
IDF announced strike on a senior Hamas commander in Gaza City, later identified as Abu Nahal. (Source: @manniefabian/59576)

Defense Minister Katz declared Israel will not allow Iran to obtain chemical weapons, stating prevailing view across defense establishment is to prevent such capability; monitoring ongoing for several months. (Source: @amitsegal/67502, @yediotnews25/138490)

Gadi Eisenkot's party "Yashar" signed coalition agreement with Lieberman's Yisrael Beiteinu; negotiations with United Torah Judaism progressing, but talks with Likud stalled. (Source: @amitsegal/67513, @yediotnews25/138496)
Ra'am leader Mansour Abbas reportedly pledged support for security legislation in Knesset, including renewal of emergency detention orders for militants by February. (Source: @yediotnews25/138500)
Hamas confirms assassination of internal security apparatus director general Naim Abu Nahal, 50, in Israeli strike in Gaza City. (Source: @manniefabian/59578)
IDF acknowledges strike on senior Hamas commander in Gaza City, later identified as Abu Nahal. (Source: @manniefabian/59576)
Joint Netanyahu-Katz statement reveals predecessor of Abu Nahal was captured by Israeli forces in a daring operation three months earlier. (Source: @manniefabian/59579)
Hamas interior ministry issued formal statement confirming the assassination. (Source: @manniefabian/59578)

24 Nov 2026 recorded 143 alerts across southern Lebanon: 75 drone detections, 40 artillery strikes; highest concentrations in Bint Jbeil district (37), Tyre district (32), Marjayoun district (31), Nabatieh governorate total 78; towns of Hadatha and Tallousa each 8 alerts. (Source: @redlinkleb/54921)

Alerts decreased 4% from previous day (149), but weekly total 292 alerts represents 54% increase over same period last week; November cumulative 2,913 alerts, up 19% from October. (Source: @redlinkleb/54921)

Second drone explosion reported in Al-Rajm area of Mifdon; large explosion by Israeli forces in Al-Tiri approximately 40 minutes prior to report; Israeli forces dropping illumination flares toward Zahrani River; artillery shelling targeting Wadi Al-Saluqi. (Source: @redlinkleb/54848, @redlinkleb/54901, @redlinkleb/54912, @redlinkleb/54919)

Qabrikha municipality urged residents to avoid areas of security incidents after booby-trapped drone exploded near maintenance crews from Electricité du Liban (Murad company) working on power lines in Arisha area. (Source: @redlinkleb/54868)

UK imposes sanctions on Houthi movement and four senior officials for deliberately undermining Middle East stability and serious human rights abuses; Foreign Secretary Miliband condemns renewed aggression targeting partners and civilians. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/10371)

US Embassy Jerusalem issues security alert warning Americans across Middle East of Houthi attack threats and Iranian efforts targeting US officials and facilities, including possible airspace closures and flight cancellations. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/10383)
UKMTO releases maritime warnings 220-26 and 221-26 for 24 Nov 2026, indicating ongoing maritime security concerns in regional waters. (Source: @shin_persian/12833, @shin_persian/12834)
